  Restoring never removes anything. To remove these by hand: sudo pacman -Rns steam wine
  To undo a whole change, roll back to before it with snapper or btrfs-assistant.

  Not in the backup, re-download after restoring: 2 Steam games (45.0 GB), Rust toolchains, Browser caches
  The full list is saved to ~/not-backed-up.md when you apply the restore.
